name: ui-apexpages-standard-set-pagination-runtime

source.content: Account first = new Account(Name = 'First'); Account second = new Account(Name = 'Second'); List<SObject> controllerRecords = new List<SObject>{first, second}; insert new List<Account>{first, second}; ApexPages.StandardSetController controller = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(controllerRecords); System.assertEquals(2, controller.getResultSize()); System.assertEquals('First', controller.getRecords()[0].Name); System.assertEquals(1, controller.getListViewOptions().size()); System.assertEquals(true, controller.getCompleteResult()); controller.setFilterID('00B000000000001'); System.assertEquals('00B000000000001', controller.getFilterId()); List<SObject> selected = new List<SObject>{second}; controller.setSelected(selected); System.assertEquals(1, controller.getSelected().size()); PageReference cancelled = controller.cancel(); System.assertEquals('/home/home.jsp', cancelled.getUrl()); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); ApexPages.StandardSetController locatorController = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(locator); System.assertEquals(2, locatorController.getResultSize()); locatorController.setPageSize(1); System.assertEquals(1, locatorController.getPageSize()); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, locatorController.getRecord().getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals('First', locatorController.getRecords()[0].Name); System.assert(locatorController.getHasNext()); locatorController.next(); System.assertEquals('Second', locatorController.getRecords()[0].Name); System.assertEquals(2, locatorController.getPageNumber()); System.assert(locatorController.getHasPrevious()); locatorController.setpageNumber(2); System.assertEquals(2, locatorController.getPageNumber()); locatorController.previous(); System.assertEquals(1, locatorController.getPageNumber()); locatorController.first(); System.assertEquals(1, locatorController.getPageNumber()); locatorController.last(); System.assertEquals(2, locatorController.getPageNumber()); PageReference saved = locatorController.save(); System.assertEquals('/home/home.jsp', saved.getUrl());
